$comment: T-414: single machine-readable SoT for the prdt hook roster. install.sh §4 (jq --slurpfile) and packages/gui/electron/ipc/onboarding.ts (installPrdtHooks) both derive their ~/.claude/settings.json `hooks` registration from THIS file — neither hand-writes the event/matcher/order shape anymore. Edit here, not in either derived site. `basenames` is the flat roster (order = install.sh §1 mirror-copy order); `registrations` is the ordered list of {event, matcher?, hooks[]} entries each derivation reduces over, in registration order. `hooks[]` entries are basenames from ~/.prdt/hooks/ — install.sh prefixes `$PRDT_HOME/hooks/`, onboarding.ts prefixes the equivalent `<homeDir>/.prdt/hooks/`, both quoting the final command string. T-445: the discipline precedence is `canonical < machine override < project override`, and array order alone does NOT enforce it — measured 2026-08-12 on Claude Code 2.1.228, hooks sharing a matcher run in PARALLEL and their additionalContext blocks are appended in COMPLETION order (a 0.6s sleep in the machine hook made its block land AFTER the project block, registration order unchanged). Precedence is therefore carried by the payload TEXT: each override payload names its own layer and who outranks it. Keep prdt-overrides-inject.sh second-to-last and prdt-project-overrides-inject.sh last anyway — that is the intended order and the usual outcome — but never let position be the only carrier. T-491: the call governor is registered on TWO events, both MATCHER-LESS on purpose — it counts one API turn per PostToolBatch and enforces on every PreToolUse, so a tool matcher would make the count depend on WHICH tools a worker happened to use. The pair is atomic: registering the PreToolUse half without the PostToolBatch half leaves an enforcer reading a counter nothing increments, i.e. silent non-enforcement. Since §8 r6 measured that the harness accepts a typo'd event name with no error at all, the governor stamps a per-event fire marker under $PRDT_HOME/run/call-governor/ and `prdt doctor` reports an event registered here that has never fired. Keep the four small inject hooks on the compact matcher too: without them a compaction re-injects the discipline set but silently drops audience-mode, plan-tier and BOTH override layers.
